plainTranslation: A's identity meets B's growth. The sextile supports them, if you act on it.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Synced from authored synastry bundle synastry-authored__19_ (2).json.
summaryDeep: Their sense of identity, confidence, and direction work smoothly with your judgment about what's possible. It runs easily and asks little, quietly steadying the rest of the bond. Lean on how naturally this one lines up.
tension: The challenge is that you have to let them in. If you keep your hopes to yourself or wait until everything is figured out before sharing it, you may never experience the full support this connection can offer.
advice: Talk about what you want before you have everything figured out. Share the goal while it is still a work in progress. This connection becomes most useful when you let this person support your growth, challenge you to think bigger, and hold you accountable to what you say you want.
summaryShort: Their sense of identity, confidence, and direction work smoothly with your judgment about what's possible.
